question: On eight fixed public targets, what product/inversion tradeoff results from carrying normalization seeds homogeneously through the source?

claims.text: Every panel row returns the checked scalar and independently verifies its point.
Candidate is a strict Pareto improvement in query-plus-verification field products and inversions on every fixed target.
claims.if_supported: Report only dominance in the two counted field-operation dimensions; no total-cost or timing inference.
claims.if_not_supported: Report all product/inversion deltas and weighted-model thresholds, including regression and mixed outcomes.

positive.not_applicable_reason: All24 rows have known-answer scalar and independent point verification; malformed output invalidates the panel.

stopping_rules.rule: Exactly3 arms x8 targets=24 rows plus separately recorded setup/preparation; retain every failure, stop on deadline; no replacement trials.

invalidation_rules: Any point verification or A/A arithmetic mismatch invalidates the comparison; preserve all rows.
No performance claim from diagnostics or unisolated clocks.

decision_rule.text: Require verified complete rows and full A/A equality. Candidate dominates only if products and inversions are both nonincreasing and at least one strictly decreases at every target. Symmetric rule for regression; otherwise tradeoff/mixed. Preserve all secondary counts.
decision_rule.threshold: Per-target strict Pareto relation in products/inversions only
decision_rule.statistic: Exact paired product and inversion differences; delta_cost = delta_products + w*delta_inversions for symbolic constant w>=0, excluding other costs
decision_rule.interval: Exact fixed-fixture values; no confidence interval
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Signed integer deltas and exact rational break-even w; no chosen weight or timing conclusion
